definition: A classifier trained using a defined set of principles to detect and filter harmful inputs or outputs in an AI system, in a manner analogous to Constitutional AI training.
details: Constitutional classifiers extend the idea of principle-guided AI training into standalone filtering systems, used to guard against jailbreak attempts and harmful content at the input/output boundary of a deployed model.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. Think of it this way: A classifier trained using a defined set of principles to detect and filter harmful inputs or outputs in an AI system, in a manner analogous to Constitutional AI training. And here is the clever part: Constitutional classifiers extend the idea of principle-guided AI training into standalone filtering systems, used to guard against jailbreak attempts and harmful content at the input/output boundary of a deployed model. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” And that is Constitutional Classifier — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
